release_notes:
Safety improvements to the Duplicate Finder, after a customer report.

If a duplicate lives in a folder that syncs to the cloud - OneDrive, Google Drive, Dropbox and others - deleting it removes it from your other devices too, and the Recycle Bin on this PC can only bring back this PC's copy. PC AutoPilot now says so plainly before you delete, instead of promising the file is recoverable.

Select All Extras no longer ticks cloud-synced copies, or copies filed in a different folder inside your Pictures or Documents. You can still tick them yourself. Deleting now asks you to confirm, and tells you how many folders are affected, not just how many files.

Before a scan starts, PC AutoPilot tells you how many subfolders it will reach and which cloud service, if any, is syncing them.

Also fixed: on smaller screens the results window could open taller than the display, putting the buttons off the bottom edge. Trial reminders could appear out of order.
